question: What will be the closing value of front-month silver futures (SI=F on Yahoo Finance) on September 5, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to the daily close of SI=F on Yahoo Finance for 2026-09-05. If there is no close on that date (weekend or holiday), the last close before it is used.
baseline:

research:
Silver futures (SI=F) closed at **69.466 on 2026-08-21**, after a sharp August rally. Nothing has happened yet that settles the question. September 5, 2026 is a Saturday, so the resolving value is **the close on Friday September 4**. That is also the day the August jobs report comes out. Most article pages wouldn't load (the proxy refused the connection), so much of this comes from search-result summaries rather than full pages.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-08-21: The latest close in the code-collected Yahoo Finance data for SI=F is 69.466. Other sources give different "close" numbers for the same day: Kitco says "just above $69", StatMuse $68.99, SilverPrice 68.23. Those likely use different price series or cut-off times. [Kitco](https://www.kitco.com/opinion/2026-08-21/gold-and-silver-cap-strong-week-dollar-faith-wavers-warsh-faces-first-test), [StatMuse](https://www.statmuse.com/money/ask/silver-price-per-ounce-august-2026-chart), [silverprice.org](https://silverprice.org/gold-price-today/2026-08-21)
- Calendar: there are 10 trading days from 2026-08-24 to 2026-09-04, which matches the code baseline.
- Contract roll: on 2026-08-21 SI=F was quoting the September contract, which opened at $68.20. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/investing/article/silver-prices-today-friday-august-21-2026-silver-pushes-higher-on-weaker-dollar-161325787.html) The September contract's first notice day falls around the end of August. If Yahoo switches SI=F to the December contract before Sept 4, the quote could jump slightly, because later contracts are usually priced a bit higher. I couldn't confirm when Yahoo makes that switch.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. Price on 2026-08-21: about $69.5. That is far from both ends of the 40 to 100 range.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-21: Silver futures rose 2.09% on the day and 6.46% on the week. Next week's Jackson Hole symposium is Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's first test. Markets see a September hold as about twice as likely as a hike. [Kitco](https://www.kitco.com/opinion/2026-08-21/gold-and-silver-cap-strong-week-dollar-faith-wavers-warsh-faces-first-test)
- 2026-08-21: Silver reached about $70.08, its first move above $70 since mid-June. Gold hit a three-month high as the dollar weakened. [Forbes](https://www.forbes.com/sites/conormurray/2026/08/21/gold-reaches-highest-price-in-three-months-as-dollar-weakens/)
- About 2026-08-21: Silver's August gain is over 20% and it is at a nearly two-month high. [TradingKey](https://www.tradingkey.com/analysis/commodities/metal/262137990-), [Mining.com](https://www.mining.com/silver-price-20-august-surge-sends-miners-soaring/)
- About 2026-08-20: OCBC's Christopher Wong said further gains would need silver to clearly break above the $70.60 to $72 range, plus a weaker dollar and lower yields. Some of the drop in yields has already reversed, and 10-year and 30-year yields are near their highs for the year. Markets price about a 34% chance of a September hike, down from about 60% three weeks earlier. [Mining.com](https://www.mining.com/gold-silver-miners-surge-as-treasury-doubles-buybacks/)
- 2026-08-19: The Treasury said it will at least double its buybacks of longer-dated bonds, starting September 9. The dollar index fell to about 98.8, and silver rose about 3.3% to about $65.44. [FXStreet](https://www.fxstreet.com/news/silver-surges-as-treasury-buyback-plan-sinks-the-us-dollar-202608191908)
- Other drivers analysts mention: the US-Iran peace process and a possible reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. [Free Press Journal](https://www.freepressjournal.in/amp/business/gold-silver-may-extend-rally-next-week-us-inflation-data-fed-signals-in-focus)

## 4. Base rates and recent values
- Code baseline (empirical 10-day returns over 3 years) for the Sept 4 close: p5 60.6, p10 63.5, p25 67.1, **p50 70.8**, p75 74.6, p90 78.7, p95 81.3.
- 2026 so far, an unusually volatile year:
  - 2026-01-29: record high of about $121.6 to $121.8.
  - 2026-01-30: a crash of about 30 to 33% within days, after CME margin hikes forced selling.
  - 2026-03-02: futures high of $97.555.
  - 2026-06-26: low of about $55.7 to $56.1.
  - July: prices stayed in the mid-to-high $50s, with a low of $55.33 on 2026-07-17 and a weekly close of $57.78 for the week ending 2026-07-31.
  
  [Monex](https://www.monex.com/silver-market-outlook-july-2026.md), [CQG](https://news.cqg.com/blogs/commentary/2026/06/silver-heading-test-technical-support), [Farms.com](https://www.farms.com/markets/commodity/silver-commodity-update-for-the-week-ending-jul-31-2026)
- Trend: a strong rebound from about $57.8 at end-July to about $69.5, roughly +20% in three weeks. Moves of 6% in a week have been common in 2026.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market for silver in early September 2026. The only ones I found were May 2026 contracts that have already expired. [SimpleFunctions](https://simplefunctions.dev/answer/what-silver-xagusd-hit-may)
- One analyst preview expects the bias to stay positive but says some profit-taking can't be ruled out. [Free Press Journal](https://www.freepressjournal.in/amp/business/gold-silver-may-extend-rally-next-week-us-inflation-data-fed-signals-in-focus)
- I didn't find any formal bank forecast published in August. An older JPMorgan view warned silver could fall back to $50 in 2026. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/silver-price-predictions-why-jpmorgan-123001668.html)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-08-27 to 08-29: Jackson Hole symposium, with Warsh's first keynote as Fed Chair. A hawkish or dovish signal on a September hike is a key risk for the dollar and for silver. [Free Press Journal](https://www.freepressjournal.in/amp/business/gold-silver-may-extend-rally-next-week-us-inflation-data-fed-signals-in-focus)
- About late August: the September contract reaches first notice day, and Yahoo's SI=F may switch contracts around then.
- 2026-09-04, 8:30 ET: the August jobs report comes out on the resolution day itself. It is the last major labor reading before the Sept 15 to 16 FOMC meeting. [Regards of Wall Street](https://www.regardsofwallstreet.com/news/september-2026-fed-meeting-dates-hike-odds)
- 2026-09-07: Labor Day. It falls after resolution, but it can thin out trading on Sept 4.
- 2026-09-09: the larger Treasury buybacks start. That is after resolution, but expectations about them can move prices beforehand. [FXStreet](https://www.fxstreet.com/news/silver-surges-as-treasury-buyback-plan-sinks-the-us-dollar-202608191908)
- Ongoing: the dollar and yields, US-Iran and Strait of Hormuz headlines, and possible profit-taking after a 20%+ monthly gain.
